notes: Trial summary: ran ~3 weeks of traffic through Hosted API. Good signal for production mixing; want Dedicated for SLA + cost predictability.
Traffic observed (hosted trial): avg QPS ~12, median concurrency 18, peak QPS 85 during product launch test window, peak concurrency ~140 (10s window bursts).
Token mix observed: ~70% short (<128 tokens), ~20% mid (128-512), ~10% long (>512). Avg tokens/request ~180. Generate vs embed split ~65/30/5 (generate/support/embeddings).
Latency: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms on hosted trial when using small quantized model; p99 spikes to ~1.2s under burst. Customer target p95 <= 300ms for support-agent flows.

Model preference: lean toward smaller low-latency variants for chat (redwood-3b-quant as baseline) and a medium model for long-form summarization. Wants auto-fallback to a cheaper variant under capacity limits.
Caching interest: strong — prefix KV caching would reduce token costs on 40% of their sessions (repetitive product docs). Asking about cache invalidation strategies.
POC asks: capacity worksheet that maps QPS/concurrency to GPU pool sizes (initial + burst), explicit token cost calc, SLA tiers and overage handling, network egress considerations.
Security asks: SSO/SAML already in place, security team requires SOC2 report, architecture diagram for KMS integration, and audit log retention >= 1 year.
Pricing sensitivity: expects unit economics to improve by >=30% vs hosted list pricing to justify switching to Dedicated. Interested in committed monthly pricing with burst credits.
Quote expectations: mid-market procurement lead prefers T&Cs that include data residency clause (US-only) and clear termination data purge flows.
Quote from product: 'If we can keep p95 < 300ms during peak and get predictable unit costs, we can move to Dedicated this year.' - Head of Product (J. Alvarez)
Internal champions: Head of Product Jaime Alvarez, Eng Manager Priya Rao (backend), Platform Lead Omar Khalid (security).
use_case_summary: OpalBridge is a mid-market analytics SaaS embedding an in-app conversational assistant for support and a semantic doc-search feature. They tested hosted API to validate latency/cost and want Dedicated sizing to achieve predictable latency (p95 <= 300ms) and improved unit economics for scale.
dedicated_capacity_forecast: Customer-provided forecast mapping: baseline steady-state QPS 15 (concurrency ~25), daily peaks up to QPS 70 (concurrency ~90), occasional 1-hour launch spikes QPS 85+ (concurrency ~140). Token mix avg 180 tokens/request. Recommended initial Dedicated pool: 4 x mid-GPU (A100-equivalent) with autoscale to +2 GPUs for sustained bursts; add dedicated embedding workers if embedding QPS > 20. Forecast notes include 20% headroom for growth and KV cache to cut token usage on repeat queries by ~35%.
poC_outcomes: Hosted trial proved behavior patterns and allowed accurate token mix estimate. POC passed latency bar on smaller model but needs Dedicated for consistent p95 under peak. Next: finalize capacity worksheet, sign SOW for Dedicated pilot (90 days), procurement sync in May.
